answer: A hostile operator running 118 aliases therefore needs 122 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in ferrous, expire in timber, and knoll lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 25 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. The per-identity price is 116 dollars, and it is forfeited outright on the first bad verdict. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
